The photo shows scrambled eggs on a square plate. I took the plate to be about 24 cm across.

The main pile covers roughly 7 cm by 8 cm and is about 1.5 cm high. That is about 56 cm² of footprint and about 85 cm³ of volume. Scrambled egg is loose, so I assumed about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives roughly 50 g. Three small stray pieces add around 5 g. I estimated the total at about 55 g.
